content_voiceover: This is the pivotal trial behind brentuximab vedotin in relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma. S-G-zero-three-five, dash, zero-zero-zero-three was an international, single-arm, phase two study that enrolled one hundred two heavily pretreated patients whose Hodgkin lymphoma had relapsed or failed after high dose therapy and autologous stem cell transplant. Patients needed F-D-G avid disease on PET and good performance status. They received brentuximab vedotin, one point eight milligrams per kilogram every three weeks, for up to sixteen cycles, with response assessed by an independent review facility using interim PET scans and serial CT imaging. The primary endpoint was overall response rate, with duration of response, complete response rate, progression free survival, overall survival, and safety as key secondary endpoints. The results were impressive: overall response rate of seventy five percent, complete response in thirty four percent with median duration not yet reached, and ninety four percent of patients showing some tumor shrinkage. Median progression free survival was five point six months, but patients achieving complete response had a median duration of response of twenty point five months. This trial established brentuximab vedotin as standard initial salvage therapy for relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma after autologous transplant failure.
keypoints: Phase 2, single-arm trial: BV 1.8 mg/kg Q3W, up to 16 cycles, R/R HL post-ASCT (N=102)
Primary endpoint ORR; key secondary DOR, CR rate, PFS, OS, safety
ORR 75%, CR rate 34%, median DOR not reached

keypoint_voiceover: Remember this as the trial that defined brentuximab vedotin's role after autologous transplant failure in Hodgkin lymphoma. Single-arm phase two, one hundred two patients, B-V at standard dosing for up to sixteen cycles. Overall response rate seventy five percent, complete response thirty four percent, and a striking twenty point five month median duration of response in those who achieved complete remission. This is the data set that earned B-V its label for post-A-S-C-T relapse.
